actions.authority: district administration (Office of Teaching & Learning + ITS); later listed by ISBE as a model policy
actions.summary: Published an AI Guidebook: students use district-approved AI tools with teacher permission, teachers encouraged to integrate AI with age-appropriate guidance; 2024-25 a learning year, full implementation 2025-26.
actions.notes: Release date is approximate (coverage dated 2024-08-16 says 'last week'). Counter-current worth watching: in August 2026 Illinois Families for Public Schools asked candidates for Chicago's first fully elected school board to pledge a three-year generative-AI moratorium; about two dozen signed. Enrollment figure is approximate.

actions.authority: school board candidate pledge ahead of the November 2026 election
actions.summary: A majority of candidates for the Chicago Board of Education have signed an advocacy pledge to push for a three-year pause on generative AI in CPS classrooms, organized by Illinois Families for Public Schools alongside a parent campaign for tighter limits.
actions.notes: NOT a district action - this is a candidate pledge before the November 2026 board election, filed as proposed because it is the live proposal in the country's fourth-largest district and cuts against the district's own 2024 permissive guidance (the other CPS row). Drop or re-date it after the election. Enrollment approximate.
